title: 第20章 俯首敬畏第19章 拦路硬闯
content_zh:
而此刻，巨门前方的气氛已然变得剑拔弩张，越来越多的角斗士从城内涌出。
不仅如此，紧随其后还有两座体型将近五米的守卫魔像，其手中各持一柄巨型战斧，胸口的熔炉中还散发着灼人的热浪。
凯撒神色平静地看着这些拦路的守卫，心中却在盘算着，是把他们制服，还是索性全都宰掉……
在真正成为半神的那一刻，他能感受到自己的意志，正在发生某种潜移默化的转变。
对于这些和自己没有半点关联的凡俗生命，他的耐心是越来越差了。
而就在这时，人群中一名身披金袍的鉴定者，似乎看出了几人的不凡。
他让身旁的角斗士迅速回城传信，随后面带笑意地看着凯撒，语气倒是客气得很：“看来阁下身上的东西非同寻常，是想要提前鉴定进城吗？”
凯撒没有理会那些严阵以待的守卫，依旧自顾自地走向城内，只是在掠过那名金袍鉴定者时，神色平静地开口：“我只是要……进城而已。”
话音落下，金袍鉴定者的笑容微微一僵，当即便准备指挥守卫魔象动手，将这些没有敬畏之心的闯入者制服之后剥皮示众。
嗡——！
可还没等守卫者有所动作，远处观望的众人便惊骇地发现，城门处数百名严阵以待的角斗士竟然全部瘫倒在地。
“龙脉压迫……不愧是单人屠龙的狠角色！”
而此时，从冰雪之路赶过来的龙纹青年，远远看着那道身披长袍的背影，眼中满是崇拜和向往。
与此同时，人群中一些经历过交界地海兽潮、以及在地狱岛上亲眼目睹过那场战斗的猎魔人和佣兵，此刻皆是神色敬畏地望着青年。
他们虽然清楚埃斯弗洛王城守卫森严，但这位曾经展现出的力量过于震撼。
那战斗场面简直堪称神话时代的重现，凡人站在那种层次的力量面前，只会被瞬间碾碎。
凯撒没有理会晕厥的守卫，而是看向那两尊仍然矗立在原地的魔像，拥有傀儡学的基础，只一眼就看出了它们的命令核心所在。
于是，他直接走到两座魔像后方，轻轻敲了敲一处微微凸起的金属：“把这些家伙拖走。”
嗡——！
刹那间，两尊魔像眼中的光芒闪烁了几下，仿佛收到了全新的指令。

它们居然真的开始清理起这些角斗士，将其缓缓码放到城墙两侧。
“臭小子，你这可是在帝国头上跳舞。”
老乞丐面色凝重地听着城内传来的动静，很想劝凯撒现在就离开，但他并不认为这家伙会同意。
凯撒却饶有兴致地看着老乞丐，隐隐猜到这家伙的身份非同寻常：“老家伙，你好像对这座城很熟悉啊。”
老乞丐此刻也没了开玩笑的心思，神色复杂地望向那座高耸入云的冰山，最终只是低声呢喃了一句：“我曾经是这里的……”
然而话音未落，城内便迅速涌来了数百名身穿狼皮护甲、手持冰晶长弓的精锐战士。
而为首的是一名身形精瘦、面容年轻的少年，同样手持一柄冰晶长弓。
只不过他手中的武器明显不同，弓身上雕刻着几枚符文，此刻正隐隐散发着幽蓝色的寒光。
那少年一看见老乞丐，脸上顿时露出了一抹戏谑的神色，当即便开口讥讽：“我当是谁呢，原来是大名鼎鼎的老城主回来了。”
content_en:
At this moment, the atmosphere in front of the giant gate has become tense, and more and more gladiators are pouring out of the city.
Not only that, but there were two guard golems nearly five meters in size behind them, each holding a giant battle ax in their hands, and the furnace on their chests was still emitting scorching heat waves.
Caesar looked at the guards blocking the road calmly, but he was thinking in his heart whether to subdue them or simply kill them all...
At the moment when he truly became a demigod, he could feel that his will was undergoing some subtle transformation.
His patience with these mortal beings that had nothing to do with him was getting worse and worse.
At this moment, an appraiser in a golden robe in the crowd seemed to notice the extraordinaryness of several people.
He asked the gladiator beside him to quickly return to the city to deliver the message, and then looked at Caesar with a smile, and his tone was very polite: "It seems that the thing on your body is unusual. Do you want to enter the city for appraisal in advance?"
Caesar ignored the well-formed guards and continued to walk towards the city. But when he passed by the gold-robed appraiser, he said calmly: "I just want to... enter the city."
After the words fell, the smile of the golden-robed appraiser froze slightly, and he was ready to command the guarding demon elephant to take action, subdue these intruders without awe, and then skin them for public display.
Buzz—!
But before the defenders could make any move, the people watching from a distance were horrified to find that hundreds of gladiators waiting at the city gate had all collapsed to the ground.
"Dragon Vein Oppression... He is indeed a ruthless character who can slay a dragon alone!"
At this time, the young man with the dragon pattern who came from the ice and snow road looked at the robed figure from a distance, his eyes full of admiration and yearning.
At the same time, some demon hunters and mercenaries in the crowd who had experienced the sea beast tide in the border area and witnessed the battle on Hell Island were all looking at the young man in awe.
Although they knew that the Royal City of Esflor was heavily guarded, the power this man once displayed was too shocking.
The battle scene could be called a reappearance of the mythical era. A mortal standing in front of that level of power would only be crushed in an instant.
Caesar ignored the fainting guards, but looked at the two golems still standing in place. With a foundation in puppetry, he could see the core of their orders at a glance.
So, he walked directly behind the two golems and gently knocked on a slightly raised metal: "Drag these guys away."
Buzz—!
In an instant, the light in the eyes of the two demon statues flickered a few times, as if they had received new instructions.
They actually started to clean up these gladiators and slowly placed them on both sides of the city wall.
"You brat, you are dancing on the head of the empire."
The old beggar listened to the noise coming from the city with a solemn expression, and wanted to persuade Caesar to leave now, but he didn't think this guy would agree.
Caesar looked at the old beggar with interest, vaguely guessing that this guy's identity was unusual: "Old guy, you seem to be very familiar with this city."
The old beggar had no intention of joking at this moment. He looked at the towering iceberg with a complicated expression, and finally just murmured in a low voice: "I used to be from here..."
However, before he finished speaking, hundreds of elite warriors wearing wolf skin armor and holding ice crystal longbows quickly poured into the city.
The leader was a lean boy with a young face, also holding an ice crystal longbow.
It's just that the weapon in his hand is obviously different. There are several runes carved on the bow, and it is faintly emitting a blue cold light at the moment.
As soon as the young man saw the old beggar, a joking look suddenly appeared on his face, and he immediately sneered: "Who did I think it was? It turns out that the famous old city lord is back."
